description: This file exports constants and a class related to rendering or parsing a class diagram, including configuration for visual styles, relation types, diagram logic, and DOM interactions.

classes.name: c
classes.description: Represents a class member, such as a method or attribute, with parsing logic for member details, visibility, classifier, and display styling.

methods.name: getDisplayDetails
methods.description: Returns an object with display text and CSS style based on member visibility, type, parameters, and return type.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses a string to determine member visibility, name, parameters, return type, and classifier.

methods.name: parseClassifier
methods.description: Returns CSS style string based on member's classifier.
